subject: Re: SIG questionnaire — access control evidence and artifacts
messages:
From: Jordan Ellis <security@fintechco.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: FintechCo Procurement <procurement@fintechco.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: SIG follow-up — access controls (SSO/SCIM/RBAC/MFA)

Laura —

Thanks for the completed SIG questionnaire draft. A couple quick follow-ups from our security team on access controls before we sign off:

- SSO/SAML: can you provide the current SAML IdP metadata (entityID, cert) and confirm whether assertion encryption is enabled? Also confirm whether SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows are supported.
- SCIM/provisioning: we need the last 30 days of provisioning logs for a sample org (provisioned/deprovisioned events) and confirmation of SCIM v2 support and group sync behavior.
- RBAC: please supply the role matrix (roles -> permissions) and a note on how least-privilege is enforced for customer-admin vs Redwood-admin roles.
- MFA: confirm whether MFA is enforced for console/admin access and whether adaptive MFA is used for suspicious login attempts. Attachments (SAML metadata, role docs) are fine; if you can’t share full logs in email, a secure link or redacted sample is okay.

We’re trying to close the SIG validation this week — can you send artifacts or an ETA?

Thanks,
Jordan Ellis
Security Engineer, FintechCo
security@fintechco.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: SIG follow-up — access controls (SSO/SCIM/RBAC/MFA)

Jordan —

Appreciate the quick review. I attached a preliminary package (Redwood_SIG_Answers.pdf) that maps our SIG responses to the prompted areas and includes references to the artifacts you requested.

Quick answers up front:
- SSO/SAML: we support SAML 2.0, both SP-initiated and IdP-initiated. Assertion encryption is optional — enabled for enterprise customers on request. I’ve attached the current SAML metadata XML for our SP (saml_metadata.xml).
- SCIM: we implement SCIM v2 with full user lifecycle operations (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE). We will provide a 30-day provisioning sample log (see scim_provisioning_log_20260228.csv).
- RBAC: our role matrix is summarized in the attached PDF; short version — separation between customer-admin (tenant-scoped) and Redwood-admin (org-scoped) roles, with principle of least privilege applied via approval workflows for escalation rights.
- MFA: MFA is enforced for Redwood console and admin-facing services (TOTP + FIDO2 options). We do not currently do adaptive MFA by default, but risk-based step-up can be configured via our SSO policy for SAML customers.

Neha — can you work with Marcus to pull the redacted provisioning log and an export of the role matrix? Also flag whether we can enable assertion encryption for FintechCo’s tenant prior to onboarding.

Jordan — if you prefer, I can upload the artifacts to a secure Drive folder and share a short-term link. ETA for full log export: EOD today (Mar 2).

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Sales — Platform
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: Redwood_SIG_Answers.pdf, saml_metadata.xml

Subject: Fwd: SIG follow-up — access controls (action items)

Marcus — forwarding Jordan’s questions and my reply. Can you:

1) Produce a redacted 30-day SCIM provisioning log for FintechCo (CSV) with PII removed — include timestamps, event type (create/update/delete), subject user id, and target group ids.
2) Export the RBAC role matrix (CSV or spreadsheet) showing role name, scope (tenant/org), and explicit permissions.
3) Confirm whether assertion encryption can be enabled for an individual tenant and what that change impacts (cert rotation, SSO downtime).

Jordan is hoping to close the SIG this week; please mark as high priority. If you need me to notify FintechCo procurement of any compliance gating items, say the word.

Thanks —
Laura
